s00_wake: You wake up. You look in the mirror.
s00_title: What if you were Ken in Ershui?
s00_break: It's spring break. No classes for seven days!
s01_grandma: It's Monday. It's rainy today. It's seven thirty. Where are you going?
s01_ken: I'm going to the train station. I want to take a train.
s01_link: Choo-choo! You take the Jiji Line train. On the train, you write a letter.
s02_ask: It's Monday. It's cloudy today. It's three forty. Where are you going?
s02_ken: I'm going to the post office. I want to send a letter.
s03_ask: It's Tuesday. It's windy today. It's nine o'clock. Where are you going?
s03_ken: I'm going to school. I want to play basketball.
s03_link: Whoosh! The wind takes your ball. You run and run!
s04_ask: It's Wednesday. It's rainy today. It's two thirty. Where are you going?
s04_ken: I'm going to the library. I want to read some books.
s04_link: You read a book about old trains. Cool! But... achoo!
s05_ask: It's Thursday. It's cold today. It's eight fifteen. Where are you going?
s05_ken: I'm going to the hospital. I want to see a doctor.
s05_link: The doctor says, "Drink water and rest." In the afternoon, the sun comes out.
s06_ask: It's Thursday. It's sunny today. It's four o'clock. Where are you going?
s06_ken: I'm going to the bookstore. I want to buy a comic book.
s06_link: You read your comic book. Ha ha ha! Now you are hungry.
s07_ask: It's Friday. It's hot today. It's six twenty. Where are you going?
s07_ken: I'm going to the restaurant. I want to eat some dumplings.
s07_link: One, two, three... twenty dumplings! Yum!
s08_ask: It's Saturday. It's sunny today. It's ten thirty. Where are you going?
s08_ken: I'm going to the park. I want to fly a kite.
s08_link: Your kite goes up, up, up! The sun is hot. You are thirsty.
s09_ask: It's Saturday. It's hot today. It's one fifty. Where are you going?
s09_ken: I'm going to the tea shop. I want to drink bubble tea.
s09_link: Cold bubble tea on a hot day. Ahh! Tomorrow is the last day.
s10_ask: It's Sunday. It's sunny today. It's nine forty-five. Where are you going?
s10_ken: I'm going to the supermarket. I want to buy some cookies.
s10_link: Cookies for you, for Zun-Bo, and for Shuiling!
s11_ask: It's Sunday. It's cloudy today. It's two o'clock. Where are you going?
s11_ken: I'm going to the museum. I want to see old trains.
s12_look: Look! An old train, just like the train in your book!
s12_week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. What a week!
s12_end: So... what if YOU were Ken in Ershui? Where are YOU going?
